_: Regions Unexplored's muds wear as dirt, as the families' table has mud: they are built as the game's own mud is, short of their cell with mud's sound, which the rules refuse. Its ash and volcanic ash wear as sand: they fall as sand does with gravel's sound, which one build of the mod makes a sand of and another a gravel, so they are named to be the same on every edition and loader. Argillite and chalk, the rock under its own turfs, wear as stone: neither name carries a word the rules read as rock. The rest of the mod is detection's where detection places it: its other grass blocks and turfs wear as grass and its dirts and podzols as dirt by their sounds, its leaves and webbing as leaves by the mod's own tag, and its paths and farmland are refused by their words.

From Prominence's census (W4 R7, judged 2026-11-12), named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because any word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. The deepslate grass block was not judged, by this census or any edition's, nor the chalk's and cobalt's made blocks, slabs and stairs, and they are left to the rules. Deepslate prismoss and viridescent nylium were judged in the same census in W4 R13 (2026-11-13), as 26.1.2's census ruled them, so the editions match.

Grass: the alpha, argillite, chalk and stone grass blocks are turfs, judged by their living top, which wears to the soil or rock under it, and prismoss and deepslate prismoss are a living moss top as the moss block is. On Prominence's build their sounds are not the grass's: detection gave the alpha grass block dirt by its ground material, the chalk grass block nothing as rock with no stone word, and the rest nothing on a material no rule reads.

Nether: the brimsprout, cobalt, glistering, viridescent and deepslate viridescent nyliums and mycotoxic moss are nylium and fungus ground, nether by what they are wherever they lie, and cobalt obsidian is natural rock found only in the Nether; all are on a material no rule reads. Stone: the ash vent is solid natural rock, which the rules leave out for having no stone word.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.20.1 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
